top_signals.title: Inflation Data to Test Limits of Treasury Rally After Haven Bid
top_signals.summary: Bond traders are waiting for a key inflation report on Tuesday for clues on the direction of the Federal Reserve’s policy path and whether the recent Treasury rally has more room to run.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Covert Russian network exploited French riots on social media, EU report says
top_signals.summary: A separate internal assessment found accounts linked to Israel and to the U.S. MAGA movement connected the riots to radical Islam and migration.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
